steps.message: Turn on Wifi, then open the contacts app
Execute: adb shell settings get global wifi_on

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell settings get global wifi_on"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell pm list packages | grep -i contact

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell pm list packages | grep -i contact"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell cmd wifi status

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell cmd wifi status"

results.content:
Wifi is disabled
Wifi scanning is always available

steps.message: Execute: adb shell svc wifi enable

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell svc wifi enable"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell pm resolve-activity -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER -p com.google.android.contacts
